claims.text: Adding 0.1 atomic percent boron to LaFe13-xCoxSi1 will improve its magnetocaloric properties near room temperature.
The initial LaFe13-xCoxSi1 alloy is in a disordered state.
Boron doping will modify the crystal structure of LaFe13-xCoxSi1.
Boron doping will modify magnetic exchange interactions in LaFe13-xCoxSi1.
Introduced boron atoms will alter the magnetic anisotropy of LaFe13-xCoxSi1.
Boron-induced changes in magnetic anisotropy and exchange interactions will enhance the magnetocaloric effect.
At approximately 300 K under a 2 T magnetic field, 0.1 atomic percent boron doping will increase the isothermal entropy change by 20% relative to undoped LaFe13-xCoxSi1.
The magnitude of the magnetocaloric improvement depends on the alloy's specific composition and processing conditions.

contradictions.description: The prediction specifies a 20% increase over the undoped alloy, but the falsification rule says the doped ΔS must be greater than 15% of the undoped value rather than at least 15% greater than that value. As written, even no improvement could avoid falsification.
